sources.section: Check out E2B - Code Interpreting for AI apps

summary.one_liner: A collection of example code, guides and integrations showing how to build with the E2B sandbox SDK, organized by LLM provider, AI framework, MCP, and use case.
summary.what_it_does: The README is an index of examples rather than a single tool. It has a Hello World guide in TypeScript and Python, and several open-source apps (E2B AI Analyst, E2B Fragments, E2B Surf). It also has tables of examples for LLM providers (OpenAI, Anthropic, Mistral, Groq, Together AI and others) and for AI frameworks (LangChain, LangGraph, Pydantic AI, CrewAI, Vercel AI SDK and others), each showing code-interpreter or sandboxed-agent patterns. Further sections cover reinforcement learning with TRL GRPO, remote execution (Crabbox), MCP client and server examples, and standalone use cases such as running Docker or Playwright in E2B. The README also describes a nightly test runner, tests/run-examples.ts, that uploads each example into a fresh sandbox, installs its toolchain and runs it, with a pass/fail policy.
use_cases: Learn how to run code in an E2B sandbox from an AI agent
Find a code interpreter example for a specific LLM provider
Connect an MCP client or server to an E2B sandbox
Run Docker or Playwright inside a cloud sandbox
Integrate sandboxed code execution with LangChain, LangGraph, or Pydantic AI
Run a coding agent such as Claude Code or Codex inside a sandbox
how_to_run: npm test -- hello-world # run a subset by substring filter
Set E2B_API_KEY plus the relevant provider key (see .env.example)
notable: Covers many LLM providers and agent frameworks with runnable examples in one place
Nightly test runner uploads each example into a fresh sandbox, installs it and checks that it exits 0
Hello World examples need only an E2B API key, making them the easiest starting point
Includes MCP examples for Browserbase, arXiv/DuckDuckGo research and Claude Code
caveats: Most examples need a separate provider API key in addition to E2B_API_KEY
Some examples are excluded from the test suite, with reasons listed at the top of tests/run-examples.ts
The MCP Groq Exa example is marked deprecated in the README
keywords: run ai agent code in cloud
